cluster_name.title: 房间名称
cluster_name.description: 显示在房间列表里的服务器名称。

cluster_description.title: 房间描述
cluster_description.description: 显示给玩家看的服务器简介。

max_players.title: 玩家上限
max_players.description: 同时允许加入这台服务器的最大玩家数量。

game_mode.title: 游戏模式
game_mode.description: 控制死亡和重生的基础规则。

cluster_intention.title: 房间倾向
cluster_intention.description: 控制房间在服务器列表里的玩法定位。默认跟随游戏模式。

shard_bind_ip.title: Shard bind address
shard_bind_ip.description: Address used by DST shards to communicate inside the cluster. Player listener binding remains instance network state.

pause_when_empty.title: 无人时暂停
pause_when_empty.description: 没有玩家在线时暂停世界时间。

pvp.title: 允许玩家互伤
pvp.description: 启用玩家之间的伤害判定。

vote_enabled.title: 启用投票
vote_enabled.description: 允许玩家发起常规世界投票。

offline_cluster.title: 离线模式
offline_cluster.description: 不公开服务器，仅接受同一局域网连接；Steam 服务不可用。启用“禁用数据收集”时会自动开启。

lan_only_cluster.title: 仅局域网
lan_only_cluster.description: 仅接受同一局域网内的连接。Master 与已启用 Caves 的玩家端口必须位于 10998–11018。

tick_rate.title: 同步频率
tick_rate.description: 服务器每秒向客户端发送更新的次数，通常保持默认 15。

autosaver_enabled.title: 自动存档
autosaver_enabled.description: 关闭后不会在每天结束时自动存档，但停服和手动保存仍会落盘。

enable_caves.title: 启用洞穴分片
enable_caves.description: 标准布局启用后启动 Caves 分片。Island Adventures 布局始终启动四片。关闭标准洞穴时保留存档和配置。

cluster_language.title: Cluster language
cluster_language.description: Language code advertised for this cluster in the server browser.

max_snapshots.title: World snapshots
max_snapshots.description: Number of rollback snapshots retained by the native cluster.

disable_data_collection.title: Disable data collection
disable_data_collection.description: 传递 -disabledatacollection。Klei 对该选项仅支持离线模式；启用后 LanGame 会同时开启离线模式。

backup_log_count.title: Server Log Backup Retention
backup_log_count.description: Maximum number of native server log backups to retain.

backup_log_period.title: Server Log Backup Interval (Seconds)
backup_log_period.description: Seconds between native server log backups.

friends_only.title: Friends only
friends_only.description: Passes -fo so only friends may join the server.

allow_ioopenwrite_sandbox_escape.title: Allow Mod file-write sandbox escape
allow_ioopenwrite_sandbox_escape.description: Passes -allow_ioopenwrite_sandbox_escape. Enable only for trusted Mods because it permits io.open and io.write outside the normal sandbox.

master_settings_preset.title: World settings preset
master_settings_preset.description: Select a built-in preset or enter an installed custom preset ID. Use survival as the cluster game mode. For another preset, fields still at base defaults inherit the preset; changed fields remain overrides. Extra Lua overrides can force a base default value.

master_worldgen_preset.title: World generation preset
master_worldgen_preset.description: Select a built-in preset or enter an installed custom preset ID. Generation changes affect new terrain. For another preset, fields still at base defaults inherit the preset; changed fields remain overrides. Extra Lua overrides can force a base default value.
